title: fix(types,components)!: renderer props index signatures map to unknown, not any
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi911oA3FnMcWttjcfML6MnUg)_

Part of #25918. This PR is the triage in-scope item named in the claim: `ComponentRendererProps` and the inline renderer props copies under `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/**` move from an index signature to `any` to one to `unknown`. #25918 remains open for the other items: the `(schema as any)` reads in ListView / ObjectGrid / ObjectView (a separate slice), and the `no-explicit-any` lint gate on `ui/packages/types/src`, which triage holds out of scope until the maintainer names it. No ESLint config change here.

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/types`**: `ComponentRendererProps` keeps its index signature (forwarded keys stay admitted, the SchemaRenderer forward path is untouched), but the signature maps to `unknown`, so a renderer has to narrow a forwarded key before it uses it.
- **`@object-ui/components`**: the 77 renderer props annotations (74 files) that carried an index signature to `any` now carry one to `unknown`. The class of reads that broke is declared, not cast:
  - `RendererHostProps` (new, package-local, `src/lib/renderer-host-props.ts`) types the three host keys renderers read by name and hand to their root element: `data-obj-id`, `data-obj-type` (written by `SchemaRenderer` from the node's `id` / `type`) and `style` (forwarded from `BaseSchema.style`). It is intersected into the 49 annotations that read them.
  - Host-supplied keys a single renderer reads by name are declared on that renderer: `onPageChange` (`pagination`), `onChange` / `value` (`input-otp`), `loading` (`button`), `className` (`text`), and on the form's internal `RenderFieldProps` react-hook-form's `ref` (`RefCallBack`), `field` and `emptyHint`.
  - `filter-builder` needs no cast: main's #26306 declared `value?: FilterGroup` on the renderer schema, so the read type-checks as written (seat note, head `b9a43f1d`).
- Changeset: `.changeset/25918-renderer-props-unknown-index.md` (`patch` on both packages, BREAKING type narrowing, FROM → TO migration for a renderer typed with `ComponentRendererProps`).
- sdui: no records. Since #26367 the per-package records are retired; the merge of `main` dropped `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/{types,components}.json`, and CI's Build & E2E UI regenerates `sdui.manifest.json` itself.

## Measured (origin/main 617f27eb + this branch)

- Step 0, the `base.ts` one-liner alone: 0 type errors in `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/react` and `@object-ui/core` (`type-check`, both programs each). `ComponentRendererProps` has no renderer consumer; its only readers are the reconciliation pin in `@object-ui/react` and the closed-face pin in `@object-ui/types`, which asserts the index signature exists and stays green.
- Flipping the inline copies alone: 65 errors in 49 files on components' `tsc --noEmit`; about 45 of them were the host-key class above.
- Public surface: none of the renderer props types is exported from `@object-ui/components`' entry (`src/index.ts`), so no downstream package's type-check reads them; `ComponentRendererProps` has no consumer outside the two pins.

## Tests and gates (head `b9a43f1d`; earlier readings at 67418d8f / e349c832 kept where still true)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`). `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/core` `type-check`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/ packages/types/ packages/react/src/__tests__/ComponentRendererProps.reconciliation.test.ts --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 826 passed, 1 skipped (827); Tests 14866 passed, 24 skipped.
- At head `b9a43f1d` (merge of `main` `e890bedc`), `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` exits 0: "verified: ui/packages/types/src/base.ts#ComponentRendererProps ([key: string]: any -> [key: string]: unknown)". The gate now reads ui packages (#26319) and admits an `any` → `unknown` index-signature change (D8, ADR amendment #26455, gate #26496). The changeset keeps `type-surface-only`. dispatch-gates: 28 derived, 28/28 at `b9a43f1d`.
- Dogfood full battery (owed for the `(narrowing)` arm), on head `b9a43f1d`, run as CI runs it (build `@objectstack/dogfood^...`, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`): command exit 0. Test Files 300 passed, 3 skipped (303); Tests 2494 passed, 18 skipped (2512).

## Acceptance notes

- `ActionGroupSchema` and `ActionMenuSchema` (in `action-group.tsx` / `action-menu.tsx`) are exported schema interfaces, not renderer props, and still carry an index signature to `any`; they are outside this claim and left byte-identical.
- `html-elements.tsx`'s shared `AnyProps` now has an `unknown` index signature but still types `schema: any`; that member is not an index signature and is outside this claim.
- `filter-builder`: the `FilterGroup` / `FilterBuilderRowGroup` gap is closed on `main` by #26306, so this PR no longer carries a cast there.
- `ui/AGENTS.md` #0.1 says renderer props keep their signature (tolerance); the signature is kept as an index signature, only its value type changes, which is the triage item's own wording ("forwarded keys stay admitted").
